title: Spicy Indian Crumble Parfait
description: A gluten-free, layered dessert with a spicy twist. Perfect for a snacking dessert.

ingredients.name: Spicy Fresh Fruit
ingredients.notes: such as strawberries, blueberries, or pineapple

instructions: Prepare the Indian Spiced Ginger Crumble according to package instructions.
In a separate bowl, mix together the fresh fruit and a pinch of cayenne pepper for added heat.
Layer the Indian Spiced Ginger Crumble, fresh fruit mixture, and coconut whipped cream in a parfait glass or bowl.
Repeat the layering process 2-3 times, ending with a layer of coconut whipped cream on top.
Chill the parfait in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
